```{python}
# ANSWER
import polars as pl
import numpy as np
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html()

df = pl.read_csv("names_year_csv.csv")

df = (df.filter(pl.col("name") == "Elliot")
        .with_columns(UT_ID_Percentage = (pl.col("UT") + pl.col("ID")) / pl.col("Total") * 100))

(
ggplot(df, aes(x="year", y="Total")) +
            geom_line(aes(color="name")) +
            scale_color_manual(values={"Elliot": "Blue"}) +
            scale_x_continuous(format="d") +
            geom_vline(xintercept=1982, linetype="dashed", color="Orange") +
            geom_text(x=1970, y=3000, label = "E.T. Released", size=5) +
            geom_vline(xintercept=1985, linetype="dashed", color="Orange") +
            geom_text(x=1995, y=3000, label = "Second Release", size=5) +
            geom_vline(xintercept=2002, linetype="dashed", color="Orange") +
            geom_text(x=2015, y=3000, label = "Third Release", size=5) +
            guide_legend(title="name") +
            labs(title = "Elliot...What?")
)
```
